title: Crux Comp Shimano GRX
notes: Exact current Crux Comp GRX page supports a Rider First Engineered FACT 10r carbon frame, S-Works FACT carbon fork, threaded BSA shell, 12x142 thru-axle, flat-mount disc, UDH, Shimano GRX 12-speed build and 47C/650B 2.1 clearance.
